notes: New: Erase / Flash (wipe) — installs a fresh Apple-signed iOS and wipes the device, built on idevicerestore (the same restore protocol 3uTools uses). Heavily guarded: it reads Find My / Activation Lock and BLOCKS the wipe if it detects Activation Lock is on, requires a tick-box and typing ERASE, and lets you download the latest iOS or point to your own IPSW. Test on a non-customer device first. Requires idevicerestore in your tools suite.
